import Mathlib

theorem p12 (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ n ih =>
      have hmono : f n < f (Nat.succ n) := hf (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt ih hmono)
